//: The refusal catalogue. RaftKit skills emit fixed refusal strings but there is no machine-readable stop signal, so blocker detection matches the strings that already exist. Every pattern below is transcribed from the skill that owns it — the `source` field names that file. Order matters: the first match wins, so specific rules precede `generic-cant`. When a skill changes an owned string, update it here in the same commit.

refusals.example: ❌ ORCHESTRATION REJECTED: Spec-Driven Development protocol is active. Please populate your feature spec in `docs/specs/active-feature.md` before assigning this task to the AI.
⚠️ SUBAGENT LOOP WARNING: Subagent Builder has attempted to resolve a compile issue 3 times and is consuming tokens. Pausing for human review.
Missing: superpowers. Install it with: claude plugin install superpowers@claude-plugins-official
evidence stale — inspected a1b2c3d, current e4f5g6h
nothing to raise — branch has no commits beyond target
raftkit-core is required — install it from the raftkit marketplace.
Can't read the live template — check your Asana connector, then retry.
Can't read the story — check your Asana connector, then retry.
Can't retest — "Fixed in build ___" is empty. The retest contract needs a build to test against.
Can't start the fix — the bug task is missing Steps to Reproduce.
Can't reproduce in the stated environment.
No approved planning output covers this — route it through the story/PM flow before docs init.

refusals.source: undeclared convention shared by ~8 skills; catch-all, must stay last
